title: Rabbi Yehudah bar Signa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Eichah Rabbah 1:39, reporting in Rabbi Acha's name. Perhaps the name should read Rabbi Yehudah bar Sisin, as in Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:3: Rabbi Yehudah bar Sisin; Rabbi Yudah ben Pazi in the name of Rabbi Acha.

notes.text: The text juxtaposes Yehudah bar Sisin and Yudah ben Pazi without specifying the intermediate link. The change from Signa to Sisin remains tentative.

The saved whole ToratEmet EichahRabbah1:39 scalar has Rabbi Yehudah ben Signa in Rabbi Acha’s name; whole Guggenheimer JerusalemTalmudKiddushin3:3 has Yudah bar Sisin and Yudah bar Pazi in Rabbi Acha’s name, without an intermediate connector. Supplied bar Signa and ben Pazi remain alongside those named ben/bar differences. Hyman’s proposed Signa-to-Sisin change remains perhaps; no or is inserted and no identity equation follows.

Eichah Rabbah 1:39 has Yehudah ben Signa speaking in Rabbi Acha’s name, while Guggenheimer’s Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:3:4 places Yudah bar Sisin beside Yudah bar Pazi before “in the name of Rabbi Acha.” Guggenheimer reports ben Shalom as a different reading in his notes. The witnesses leave the connection to Signa open, and Hyman’s suggested Sisin remains tentative.
